subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should OpenClaw adopt or refresh the open fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/155, replace it with a narrow first-party fix, or close that candidate before requeueing this bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but a closing-syntax fork PR already exists and automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers decide that candidate's fate.

options.title: Review or refresh the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing candidate as the starting point if its cleanup shape is acceptable, then require current checks and real Google Chat proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Replace with a narrow owner fix
options.body: Close or supersede the fork candidate and implement the same Google Chat placeholder cleanup with focused regression coverage in a fresh OpenClaw PR.

options.title: Defer the lifecycle change
options.body: Keep the issue open without a new fix lane if maintainers want to sequence it behind broader Google Chat placeholder work.

recommendation.title: Review or refresh the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing candidate as the starting point if its cleanup shape is acceptable, then require current checks and real Google Chat proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on Google Chat reply-delivery hardening and tests around the placeholder lifecycle.
